page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament border. Then title "PRÆFATIO" with subtitle "AD LECTOREM." centred. Below left: a woodcut emblem (roundel with motto) with initial M at left and P at right margin area; running text in one column to the right of the emblem, continuing full width below. Left and right margins hold the letters M and P beside the emblem, not notes.
page.page_number: ( ) not printed as number; page signature at foot: ")( ۱" shown as ")( ij" [?]

main_text.l: quibus nec otium, nec ingenii facultas ad illa cæterarum artium intima
indagandaconcedatur, in hac rerum à maioribus gestarum recordatione atque lucecconquiescant, eaq;
imperiti, perinde ac intelligentiores valde multoque etiam sæpe magis delectentur,
multum tamen semper interest, quantum commoditatis
atque fructus docti ex historiis magis quàm indocti percipiant.
Nam dum hi Heroum & magnatum casus varios domi militiæque ad mirantur,
dum ob clades & calamitates exercituum, Rerumpublicar. euersiones, ciuitatum
vastationes, rerum mutationem, bella, incendia, naufragia, atque horum
omnium varietatem, inconstantiam, & arrogantiam magna delectatione
affecti & attoniti stupent, neq; aliam vtilitatem optant, aut inesse
putant historiæ: quo quidque consilio gestum, quo authore & suafore
inceptum, in quem exitum ac euentum ptogressum, quibus modis ad finem
deductum quidquid sit, nunquam animaduertunt. Quæ sane viris
doctis atque prudentibus, quibus in rebus inutilibus, aut ad necessarium vitæ vsum non spectantibus
maxima semper fuit historias scribendi, atque legendi causa. Vt ex antecedentium

page.notes: Woodcut emblem with circular legend "SCIENTIA ... MVNDVS ... ET CONCVPISCENTIA" roundel; initial letters M and P flank the emblem. Pages' letters in margin are initials, not notes. Printed text is partly illegible in the top-left shoulder of the emblem; the opening word "Mnibus" is a large woodcut initial "O" [?] joined to it. Signature and page number at foot uncertain.
